decisive_items: Spherical broadly based budding yeast on Grocott-Gomori methenamine silver stain
response.rationale: The presence of Blastomyces urine antigen and spherical broadly based budding yeast on Grocott-Gomori methenamine silver stain are more specific to Blastomycosis than the positive Histoplasmosis blood antigen alone.

rejected.why: Lack of specificity and direct evidence for Disseminated fungal infection
